explanation: The theorem says that the addHaar measure of a specific Option-indexed basis of ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ) equals volume. That basis is the image of Pi.basisFun under LinearEquiv.piOptionEquivProd. I searched Mathlib for addHaar-and-volume lemmas and for addHaar-and-prod lemmas. The nearest hits were OrthonormalBasis.addHaar_eq_volume, Basis.prod_addHaar, Basis.map_addHaar and addHaarMeasure_eq_volume_pi. None of them states this result. Basis.prod_addHaar is about the Sum-indexed Basis.prod, not the Option-indexed basis. The OrthonormalBasis lemma needs an inner product space structure, which ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ) lacks. The proof combines Basis.map_addHaar, the pi measure identity, Measure.pi_map_piOptionEquivProd, Prod.swap and volume_eq_prod. That is more than a two-line derivation from one declaration.
